You'll work directly alongside the founders to shape how we grow our clients' businesses and our agency's capabilities, while mentoring junior team members and drawing on them for support. Your primary responsibility will be your pod of accounts, and you will also assist the founders across the business with other clients as needed.</p> <h3 class="bd-h">Key Responsibilities</h3> <h4 class="bd-sub">Whole-Business Performance</h4> <ul class="bd-list"> <li>You evaluate accounts through blended CAC, contribution of paid to total revenue, new-vs-returning mix, and retention signals, and you make day-to-day decisions off real performance. Forecasts are a guide and the actual numbers drive your decision-making. You can explain why platform ROAS alone is a bad compass.</li> </ul> <h4 class="bd-sub">Campaign Strategy &amp; Execution</h4> <ul class="bd-list"> <li>Develop and own full-funnel paid media strategies across Meta (plus potentially TikTok, Pinterest, and other platforms as needed)</li> <li>Set monthly targets grounded in the client's actual CPA and funded budget, adjusting as reality comes in</li> <li>Hands-on platform execution: budget allocation, pacing, scaling, and cutting based on performance and client KPIs</li> <li>Lead campaign setup, launch, ongoing optimization, and performance analysis across your pod</li> </ul> <h4 class="bd-sub">Analytics &amp; Reporting</h4> <ul class="bd-list"> <li>Own client-facing performance reporting — translating data into clear, actionable insights and strategic recommendations</li> <li>Build and maintain advanced dashboards using Google Sheets, Supermetrics, and similar tools</li> <li>Conduct regular account audits to identify growth and efficiency opportunities</li> <li>Establish and track KPIs, benchmarks, and forecasting models across accounts</li> </ul> <h4 class="bd-sub">Creative Strategy</h4> <ul class="bd-list"> <li>Translate revenue goals into a plan for what the creative team needs to produce, and when</li> <li>Analyze creative performance and use data to inform iteration cycles and testing roadmaps</li> <li>Build and manage structured A/B testing frameworks across creative</li> </ul> <h4 class="bd-sub">Client &amp; Team Leadership</h4> <ul class="bd-list"> <li>Serve as a primary point of contact for key client accounts, building trust through proactive communication and strategic guidance</li> <li>Lead client status calls and strategy presentations with a clear, confident perspective</li> <li>Deliver difficult news clearly and present paths to a solution</li> <li>Mentor and provide day-to-day guidance to Marketing Analysts and junior team members</li> <li>Collaborate with founders on agency operations, new business pitches, and process improvements</li> </ul> <h3 class="bd-h">How the Ramp Works</h3> <p>The timeline is quick, but the ramp is structured and gradual — we make sure you're confident before you take over, then expect you to run it day to day, with founders staying involved at the strategic level.</p> <div class="bd-ramp"> <div class="bd-ramp-card"> <ul> <li><strong>Months 1–2: </strong>Take over buying and strategy on your starting pod with founder oversight, shadowing then co-leading client calls.</li> <li><strong>Months 3–4: </strong>Lead calls solo as founders step back to strategic oversight.</li> </ul> </div> </div> <p>We'll know it's working if by month four, your pod runs seamlessly through you, and you're handling day-to-day calls, strategy, and buying.</p> <h3 class="bd-h">How We Work</h3> <p>You'll work directly with the founders who've built the systems you'll run. We give you the context, tools, and information you need, then we expect you to be independent and trust you to run with it. You arrive with the paid marketing knowledge, and we help you sharpen how you apply it.</p> <p>We have a defined way of operating — performance-led planning, a structured creative cadence, specific views on measurement — refined across years of DTC accounts. The best people we've worked with bring their own judgment and look to understand why our system works the way it does.
